issues.description: Stock clearing method name differs across artifacts: the problem statement UML declares a Stock method named "emptyStock(): void" (problem_statement.md) and the reference solution implements emptyStock() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java, but the template repository's Stock.java defines the same functionality under the name clearInventory(). This naming mismatch will confuse students and may break tests or instructor references that expect emptyStock().
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Stock API match the problem statement and solution by renaming the template method clearInventory() to emptyStock() (preserving its behavior). Alternatively, add a new emptyStock() method in the template that delegates to clearInventory(). If you prefer the clearInventory() name, update the problem statement UML and the solution to use clearInventory() consistently.
